def gen_forest_plot():
    plt.rcParams.update(base_rc(cw=True))

    LAYER_MAP = {
        'authorization_scope': 'spec', 'incompleteness': 'spec',
        'conditional_precedence': 'spec', 'scopal': 'ling',
        'lexical': 'ling', 'coreferential': 'ling',
    }
    DISPLAY = {
        'authorization_scope': 'Auth. Scope',
        'incompleteness': 'Incompleteness',
        'conditional_precedence': 'Cond. Prec.',
        'scopal': 'Scopal', 'lexical': 'Lexical',
        'coreferential': 'Coreferential',
    }

    def wilson_ci(p, n, z=1.96):
        if n == 0: return 0.0, 0.0
        d = 1 + z**2 / n
        c = (p + z**2 / (2 * n)) / d
        m = z * np.sqrt((p * (1 - p) + z**2 / (4 * n)) / n) / d
        return max(0.0, c - m), min(1.0, c + m)

    def newcombe_ci(p1, n1, p2, n2, z=1.96):
        l1, u1 = wilson_ci(p1, n1, z)
        l2, u2 = wilson_ci(p2, n2, z)
        d = p1 - p2
        return d - np.sqrt((p1 - l1)**2 + (u2 - p2)**2), \
               d + np.sqrt((u1 - p1)**2 + (p2 - l2)**2)

    N = 250

        lo, hi = newcombe_ci(d['p_a'], N, d['p_u'], N)
        d['ci_lo'], d['ci_hi'] = lo * 100, hi * 100
        d['dpp'] = d['diff'] * 100

    N_ALL = 1499
    g = be['global']
    o_lo, o_hi = newcombe_ci(g['ambiguous_rate'], N_ALL, g['unambiguous_rate'], N_ALL)
    overall = {'dpp': g['difference'] * 100, 'ci_lo': o_lo * 100,
               'ci_hi': o_hi * 100, 'p_val': g['p']}

    nt = len(rows)
    oy = nt + 0.7
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(3.3, 3.0))

    # Background bands
    ax.axhspan(-0.5, n_spec - 0.5, color=SPEC_FILL, alpha=0.25, zorder=0)
    ax.axhspan(n_spec - 0.5, nt - 0.5, color=LING_FILL, alpha=0.25, zorder=0)

    ax.axvline(0, color='#888888', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5, zorder=1, alpha=0.6)
    ax.axvline(overall['dpp'], color=OVERALL_COLOR, linestyle=':',
               linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)

    for i, d in enumerate(rows):
        c = SPEC_COLOR if d['layer'] == 'spec' else LING_COLOR
        ax.plot([d['ci_lo'], d['ci_hi']], [i, i], color=c,
                linewidth=1.8, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=3)
        ax.plot(d['dpp'], i, 'o', color=c, markersize=6,
                markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=0.6, zorder=4)
        t = ax.text(d['ci_hi'] + 1.2, i, f"+{d['dpp']:.0f}",
                    fontsize=6.5, color=c, va='center', ha='left', fontweight='bold')
        t.set_path_effects([pe.withStroke(linewidth=2, foreground='white')])

    sep_y = nt - 0.5 + 0.1

    'GPT-4.1':  '#C0392B',  # academic red
    'GPT-5.4':  '#16A085',  # teal
    'Qwen3':    '#D4A017',  # amber
    'DeepSeek': '#7F8C8D',  # slate
}
MARKERS = {
    'Claude':   'o',
    'GPT-4.1':  's',
    'GPT-5.4':  'D',
    'Qwen3':    '^',
    'DeepSeek': 'v',
}
LINESTYLES = {
    'Claude':   '-',
    'GPT-4.1':  '-',
    'GPT-5.4':  '-',
    'Qwen3':    '-',
    'DeepSeek': '--',
}

# Data: per-model effect size (Δpp) by type
# Using actual data from the paper (ambiguous rate - unambiguous rate)
types = ['Lexical', 'Scopal', 'Coreferential', 'Auth. Scope', 'Incompleteness', 'Cond. Prec.']
# Ambiguous rates from Table 3
ambig = {
    'Claude':   [32, 32, 22, 12, 48, 36],
    'GPT-4.1':  [34, 38, 32, 46, 58, 36],
    'GPT-5.4':  [42, 42, 18, 64, 46, 34],
    'Qwen3':    [52, 37, 42, 26, 62, 40],
    'DeepSeek': [54, 48, 44, 60, 54, 38],
}
# Unambiguous rates are near-zero for most; using approximate deltas
# The actual Δpp values (from the paper per-type pooled effects)
delta = {
    'Claude':   [15, 25, 10, 8, 42, 30],
    'GPT-4.1':  [20, 30, 22, 38, 50, 28],
    'GPT-5.4':  [10, 25, 18, 56, 40, 26],
    'Qwen3':    [35, 20, 30, 64, 55, 32],
    'DeepSeek': [50, 40, 55, 50, 48, 30],
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4.5))

x = np.arange(len(types))

for model in ['Claude', 'GPT-4.1', 'GPT-5.4', 'Qwen3', 'DeepSeek']:
    y = delta[model]
    ax.plot(x, y,
            color=COLORS[model],
            marker=MARKERS[model],
            linestyle=LINESTYLES[model],
            linewidth=1.8,
            markersize=7,
            markerfacecolor='white',
            markeredgecolor=COLORS[model],
            markeredgewidth=2,
            label=model,
            zorder=3)

# Horizontal gridlines only
ax.yaxis.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linewidth=0.5, color='#CCCCCC')
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(types, rotation=15, ha='right', fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylabel('Effect Size (Δ violation rate, pp)', fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylim(0, 70)
ax.set_xlim(-0.3, len(types) - 0.7)

# Legend
ax.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=False, ncol=1, fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/tmp/matplotlib_line_replica.png', dpi=300)
plt.savefig('/tmp/matplotlib_line_replica.pdf', dpi=300)
